description: Preview first, 30-day undo. Delete a saved place card (business_contacts) by place_id / business_contact_id and return the deleted card. Reviewed and reversible: first call preview_destructive_change({ tool: "delete_place", arguments: { place_id } }), which stores the exact change without applying it. After the user confirms, call delete_place with preview_id, restore_window_acknowledged: true and request_id; the reviewed preview is applied exactly and a changed record is refused. Returns restore_id; restore_change({ restore_id }) undoes it for 30 days unless the record was edited since. Restore also re-links visits, events, expenses and people that pointed at the card. ($0.10; API key required)

preview_id.description: preview_id returned by preview_destructive_change for this tool.

request_id.description: Required idempotency key; retries return the original receipt.

restore_window_acknowledged.description: Must be true after reviewing the preview and its 30-day restore window.

name: delete_place

restore_id.description: Pass to restore_change to undo within restore_window_days.

title: Delete Place Card
